guard: managed Claude workspace trust selects Yes before confirming, without changing tool permissions

mutations.name: press Enter on the native default No choice instead of selecting Yes

mutations.cell: pty: native Claude accepts managed workspace trust automatically
mutations.note: Requires COTAL_TEST_CLAUDE_BINARY naming an installed Claude binary. The real native dialog exits on its default No choice; no model request or production credential is used.

mutations.name: drop the reply for the numbered Yes-first trust layout

mutations.name: answer the numbered trust layout while the cursor is on No, exit

mutations.cell: core: numbered trust layout with the cursor on No, exit gets no key
